name: HackerOne
description: Monitor HackerOne bug bounty program for security research and vulnerability management compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to HackerOne at https://hackerone.com
2. Go to your organization → Settings → API Tokens (org-admin required)
3. Click 'Create API Token', enter an identifier name, copy the generated token value (shown once)
4. Paste the identifier and token below — Comp will base64-encode them for HTTP Basic auth

credentialFields.label: API Identifier
credentialFields.helpText: The API identifier (username) of an API token created in HackerOne. Create at https://hackerone.com/organizations/<your-org>/api_tokens.

credentialFields.label: API Token
credentialFields.helpText: The API token value generated alongside the identifier. HackerOne shows it only once at creation.
